notes.title: Update to Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Update 1.5

We have been working hard on  updating the version of Unity that Hero Mini Maker uses. We also sped up the exporting process.. but these are minor compared to what's coming in the future.

Added "Special" Tab

We have added a new tab for content and have populated it with a preview of what's to come. As of now it's 5 prop pieces that can be exported with Bases or by themselves, these objects can be used to decorate the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36418676/13967fbdfc1388854df15ae391fa699a4f1ecef2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36418676/aa6ca8511915290138b4b8c03ed33c7f1cfd11f6.png

Speaking of Battlefield

We have a new software coming out that works hand in hand with Hero Mini Maker called "Digital Dungeon Tiles". You can use it on it's own or with Hero Mini Maker. have a look...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275970/Digital_Dungeon_Tiles/

More to Come!

We want everyone to be able to print their own battle map minis and decoration, we will be continuing in this direction :)
